name: Morsbach (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 1:4:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Morsbach (a red lion on white above waves and plants on blue).
history: By approval of the Oberkreisdirektor as lower state authority of 28 June 1995 the municipality was granted the right to bear a hoisted flag in red, white and red; the charter describes it as divided red and white with the arms at the centre, while its annex shows a flag in the ratio 1:4:1.
